name: clear_primary_calendar
description: Clears the primary calendar by deleting all events associated with it. Only the primary calendar can be cleared using this operation. Attempting to clear a non-primary calendar will result in an error.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the primary calendar. Use the keyword "primary" to access the primary calendar of the currently logged-in user, or provide the actual calendar ID of the primary calendar. Only primary calendars can be cleared with this operation.

name: create_access_control_rule
description: Creates a new access control rule for the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to create the rule for.

sendNotifications.description: Whether to send notifications to the rule's scope. Defaults to True.

resource.description:
The rule details.
- role (str): The role to assign (e.g., 'reader', 'writer').
- scope (dict): The scope of the rule:
    - type (str): The type of scope (e.g., 'user', 'group', 'domain', 'default').
    - value (str): The value of the scope (e.g., email address or domain). Required when type is 'user', 'group', or 'domain'; empty string for type 'default'.
- ruleId (str, optional): The ID of the rule. If not provided, one will be generated.

value.description: The value of the scope (e.g., email address or domain). Required when type is 'user', 'group', or 'domain'; empty string for type 'default'.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule. If not provided, one will be generated.

name: create_calendar_list_entry
description: Creates a new calendar list entry in the user's calendar list.

colorRgbFormat.description: Whether to use the foregroundColor and backgroundColor fields to write the calendar colors (RGB). If this feature is used, the index-based colorId field will be set to the best matching option automatically. Optional. The default is False.

resource.description: The resource to create the calendar list entry with.

id.description: The ID of the calendar list entry. Cannot be empty and must not exceed 255 characters.

summary.description: READ-ONLY: The summary comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

description.description: READ-ONLY: The description comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

timeZone.description: READ-ONLY: The timeZone comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

location.description: READ-ONLY: The location comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

primary.description: READ-ONLY: The primary flag comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

summaryOverride.description: The summary that the authenticated user has set for this calendar. This overrides the read-only summary field for display purposes.

selected.description: Whether the calendar content shows up in the calendar UI. Defaults to False.

colorId.description: The color of the calendar. This is an ID referring to an entry in the calendar section of the colors definition (see the colors endpoint). This property is superseded by the backgroundColor and foregroundColor properties and can be ignored when using these properties. Optional.

backgroundColor.description: The main color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format '#0088aa'. This property supersedes the index-based colorId property. To set or change this property, you need to specify colorRgbFormat=true. Must be provided together with foregroundColor. Optional.

foregroundColor.description: The foreground color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format '#ffffff'. This property supersedes the index-based colorId property. To set or change this property, you need to specify colorRgbFormat=true. Must be provided together with backgroundColor. Optional.

hidden.description: Whether the calendar has been hidden from the list. Defaults to False.

notificationSettings.description: The notifications that the authenticated user is receiving for this calendar. Defaults to empty notifications list.

notifications.description: The list of notifications set for this calendar.

method.description: The method used to deliver the notification.

defaultReminders.description: The default reminders that the authenticated user has for this calendar. Defaults to empty list.

method.description: The method used to deliver the reminder. Required when adding a reminder.

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the event when the reminder triggers. Required when adding a reminder.

name: create_event
description: Creates a new event in the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the calendar. Defaults to the string "primary". When "primary" is provided, it is automatically mapped to the actual primary calendar ID.

resource.description: The event to create:

id.description:
The identifier of the event. If not provided,
a new UUID will be generated.

start.description: The start time of the event.

date.description: The date of the start time in format YYYY-MM-DD. Either date or dateTime field must be provided and cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the start time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. The date and dateTime field cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the start time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). The timeZone is required if the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Defaults to None.

end.description: The end time of the event.

date.description: The date of the end time in format YYYY-MM-DD. Either date or dateTime field must be provided and cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the end time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. The date and dateTime field cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the end time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). The timeZone is required if the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Defaults to None.

recurrence.description:
The recurrence rules of the event in RRULE format and exception dates in EXDATE format.
 Examples:
- Daily for 5 occurrences: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5"]
- Weekly on Monday and Wednesday: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE"]
- Monthly on the 15th: ["RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=15"]
- Yearly on January 1st: ["RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=1;BYMONTHDAY=1"]
- Every 2 weeks: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2"]
- Until a specific date: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20241231T235959Z"]
- With exception dates: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO", "EXDATE:20241225T120000Z", "EXDATE:20250101T120000Z"]
- Multiple exception dates: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10", "EXDATE:20241225T120000Z", "EXDATE:20241226T120000Z"]
- All-day event exceptions: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO", "EXDATE:20241225", "EXDATE:20250101"]
Supported RRULE parameters:
- FREQ: MINUTELY, HOURLY, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY (required)
- INTERVAL: Positive integer (default: 1)
- COUNT: Positive integer (number of occurrences)
- UNTIL: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ (UTC required; Z suffix required for date-time)
- BYDAY: SU,MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA (with optional ordinal: 1SU, -1MO)
- BYMONTH: 1-12
- BYMONTHDAY: 1-31
- BYYEARDAY: 1-366
- BYWEEKNO: 1-53
- BYHOUR: 0-23
- BYMINUTE: 0-59
- BYSECOND: 0-59
- BYSETPOS: 1-366 or -366 to -1
- WKST: SU,MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA (week start)
Supported EXDATE format:
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ (UTC timezone)
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS (floating/local time)
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDD (date only for all-day events)
- Multiple dates: Use separate EXDATE entries (not comma-separated)
Note: TZID parameter not supported in this implementation

attendees.description: List of event attendees. Each attendee can have:

organizer.description: Whether the attendee is the organizer

self.description: Whether the attendee is the user

resource.description: Whether the attendee is a resource

optional.description: Whether the attendee's presence is optional

useDefault.description: Whether to use the default reminders.

overrides.description: List of custom reminder overrides for this event. Each override specifies a method (email, popup, sms) and minutes before the event. If useDefault is False, only these overrides are used. If useDefault is True, these overrides are added in addition to the default reminders. Maximum of 5 overrides per event.

method.description: The method of the reminder (email, popup, sms). Required when adding a reminder.

minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger the reminder. Required when adding a reminder.

attachments.description: The attachments list contains the dicts and each dict has the following keys:

mimeType.description: Internet media type (MIME type) of the attachment.

iconLink.description: URL link to the attachment's icon.

fileId.description: ID of the attached file. Read-only.

status.description: Status of the event. Valid values: "confirmed" (event is confirmed), "tentative" (event is tentatively confirmed), "cancelled" (event is cancelled). Defaults to "confirmed".

organizer.description: Organizer of the event. Contains email and optional displayName.

email.description: Email address of the person. Used to identify the organizer.

displayName.description: Display name of the person. Human-readable name shown in the UI.

self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

creator.description: Creator of the event. Contains email and optional displayName.

email.description: Email address of the person. Used to identify the creator.

displayName.description: Display name of the person. Human-readable name shown in the UI.

self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

extendedProperties.description: Extended properties of the event. Allows storing custom metadata as key-value pairs. Extended properties can be private (visible only to the organizer) or shared (visible to all attendees).

private.description: Private extended properties, visible only to the event organizer. Dictionary of key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

additionalProperties.description: A key-value pair where the key is a string property name and the value is a string property value.

shared.description: Shared extended properties, visible to all event attendees. Dictionary of key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

additionalProperties.description: A key-value pair where the key is a string property name and the value is a string property value.

sendUpdates.description:
Whether to send updates about the creation.
Possible values: "all", "externalOnly", "none". Defaults to "none".

name: create_secondary_calendar
description: Creates a secondary calendar.

resource.description: The resource to create the calendar with.

id.description: The identifier of the calendar. If not provided, a UUID will be generated.

description.description: The description of the calendar. If explicitly set to null, defaults to an empty string.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to "UTC".

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Defaults to an empty string.

kind.description: Type of the resource. Must be "calendar#calendar" if provided. Defaults to "calendar#calendar" if not provided.

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description:
List of conference solution types that are supported for this calendar.
 Defaults to an empty list if not provided.
 Each string in the list can be one of:
- "eventHangout"
- "eventNamedHangout"
- "hangoutsMeet"

name: delete_access_control_rule
description: Deletes an access control rule from the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to delete the rule from.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule to delete.

name: delete_calendar_list_entry
description: Removes a calendar from the user's calendar list (unsubscribes). This only removes the calendar from the user's view - the actual calendar, events, ACL rules, and channels are NOT deleted. To delete the actual calendar, use delete_secondary_calendar.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar list entry to remove from the user's calendar list.

name: delete_event
description:
Deletes an event from the specified calendar. When deleting a parent recurring event,
also removes all associated child instance exceptions from recurring_exceptions.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the calendar containing the event to delete. If "primary" is provided, the primary calendar will be used.

eventId.description: The identifier of the event to delete.

sendUpdates.description:
Whether to send updates about the deletion.
Possible values: "all", "externalOnly", "none". Defaults to "none".

name: delete_secondary_calendar
description:
Deletes a secondary calendar. This operation removes the calendar from the user's calendar list
and cleans up all associated data including events, ACL rules, notification channels, and recurring_exceptions.

Note: Primary calendars cannot be deleted. Only the owner of the calendar can delete it.

calendarId.description:
The identifier of the secondary calendar to delete.
Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
To retrieve calendar IDs, call the `calendarList.list` method.

name: get_access_control_rule
description: Retrieves an access control rule from the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to get the rule from.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule to retrieve.

name: get_calendar_and_event_colors
description: Returns the color definitions for calendars and events.

name: get_calendar_list_entry
description: Retrieves a calendar list entry from the user's calendar list.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar list entry to retrieve. If "primary" is provided, the primary calendar will be returned.

name: get_calendar_metadata
description: Retrieves metadata for a specified calendar.

calendarId.description:
The identifier of the calendar. Cannot be empty or contain only whitespace.
- To retrieve calendar IDs, call the `calendarList.list` method.
- Use the keyword "primary" to access the primary calendar of the currently logged-in user.

name: get_event
description: Retrieves an event from the specified calendar.

alwaysIncludeEmail.description:
Deprecated. This parameter is ignored as email addresses
are always included in the response. If not provided or None is passed, False is used.

calendarId.description:
The identifier of the calendar. Optional.
To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.
If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user,
use the "primary" keyword. If not provided or None is passed, "primary" is used. Defaults to "primary".

eventId.description: The identifier of the event to retrieve. Required.

maxAttendees.description:
The maximum number of attendees to return (must be at least 1).
If there are more than the specified number of attendees, only the participant (the attendee with self=True) is returned.
Defaults to None (return all attendees).

timeZone.description:
The time zone to use for the response, in the format 'Continent/City' (e.g., "America/New_York").
An empty string is not allowed. Defaults to None (which uses the calendar's time zone).

name: import_event
description: Imports an event or creates a new event in a destination calendar. Supports two modes: (1) If full_id is provided, copies an event from the source calendar (specified in full_id) to the destination calendar (specified in calendarId). (2) If full_id is not provided, creates a new event directly in the destination calendar with the provided event data.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the destination calendar where the event will be imported to. Use "primary" for the primary calendar.

supportsAttachments.description: Whether the API client performing the operation supports event attachments. If True, attachments are included in the response. Defaults to False.

resource.description: The event to import or create. start and end are required. full_id is optional - if provided, the function imports an event from a source calendar; if omitted, the function creates a new event directly. Other fields are optional - if None (when importing), the value from the source event is kept; if provided, it overrides the source event value.

full_id.description: Optional. The full source identifier in the format "sourceCalendarId:eventId". This specifies the event to import from. The sourceCalendarId is the calendar containing the event, and eventId is the identifier of the event to import. If not provided, a new event is created with the provided data.

id.description: Optional. The identifier of the event. If not provided, a new ID will be generated.

summary.description: Optional. The summary/title of the event. If None, keeps the source event summary.

description.description: Optional. The description of the event. If None, keeps the source event description.

start.description: The start time of the event.

date.description: The date of the start time in format YYYY-MM-DD. Either date or dateTime field must be provided and cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the start time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. The date and dateTime field cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the start time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). The timeZone is required if the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Defaults to None.

end.description: The end time of the event.

date.description: The date of the end time in format YYYY-MM-DD. Either date or dateTime field must be provided and cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the end time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. The date and dateTime field cannot be provided at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the end time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). The timeZone is required if the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Defaults to None.

recurrence.description: Optional. Recurrence rules in RRULE format. If None, keeps the source event recurrence.

attendees.description: Optional. List of event attendees. If None, keeps the source event attendees.

organizer.description: Whether the attendee is the organizer.

self.description: Whether the attendee is the current user.

resource.description: Whether the attendee is a resource.

optional.description: Whether the attendee's presence is optional.

reminders.description: Optional. Reminder configuration. If None, keeps the source event reminders.

useDefault.description: Whether to use the default reminders.

minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger the reminder.

location.description: Optional. Location of the event. If None, keeps the source event location.

attachments.description: Optional. List of attachments. If None, keeps the source event attachments.

mimeType.description: Internet media type (MIME type) of the attachment.

iconLink.description: URL link to the attachment's icon.

fileId.description: ID of the attached file. Read-only.

status.description: Optional. Status of the event. If None, keeps the source event status.

organizer.description: Optional. Organizer of the event. If None, keeps the source event organizer.

self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

creator.description: Optional. Creator of the event. If None, keeps the source event creator.

self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

extendedProperties.description: Extended properties of the event. Allows storing custom metadata as key-value pairs. Extended properties can be private (visible only to the organizer) or shared (visible to all attendees).

private.description: Private extended properties, visible only to the event organizer. Dictionary of key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

additionalProperties.description: A key-value pair where the key is a string property name and the value is a string property value.

shared.description: Shared extended properties, visible to all event attendees. Dictionary of key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

additionalProperties.description: A key-value pair where the key is a string property name and the value is a string property value.

name: list_access_control_rules
description: Lists all access control rules for the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to list rules for. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of rules to return. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Token for pagination. Defaults to None.

showDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted rules. Defaults to False.

syncToken.description: Token for synchronization. Defaults to None.

name: list_calendar_list_entries
description: Lists all calendar list entries in the user's calendar list.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of calendar list entries to return. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Token for fetching the next page of results. Should be a stringified non-negative integer offset. Empty strings or whitespace-only strings are not allowed. Defaults to '0'.

showHidden.description: Whether to show hidden entries in the list. When False (default), entries with hidden=True are filtered out. When True, all entries including hidden ones are returned.

name: list_event_instances
description: Returns instances of a specified recurring event.

eventId.description: The identifier of the recurring event.

alwaysIncludeEmail.description:
Deprecated. This parameter is ignored as email addresses
are always included in the response.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the calendar. If not provided, defaults to "primary".

maxAttendees.description:
The maximum number of attendees to include in the response. If there are more than
the specified number of attendees, only the participant is returned. Optional. Defaults to None

maxResults.description:
Maximum number of events returned on one result page. By default the value is 250 events.
The page size can never be larger than 2500 events. Optional. Defaults to 250.

originalStart.description: The original start time of the instance in the result. Optional. Defaults to None.

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional. Defaults to None.

showDeleted.description:
Whether to include deleted instances.
Defaults to False.

timeMax.description:
Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time to filter by.
Optional. The default is not to filter by start time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.  Defaults to None.

timeMin.description:
Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time to filter by.
Optional. The default is not to filter by end time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.  Defaults to None.

timeZone.description:
The time zone to use for the response (e.g. "America/New_York").
Must be in format 'Continent/City'. Defaults to the calendar's time zone.

name: list_events
description: Lists events from the specified calendar.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the calendar. Defaults to "primary".

maxResults.description:
The maximum number of events to return.
Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 250. Maximum allowed value is 2500.

timeMin.description:
Lower bound (exclusive) for event end times. Must be timezone-aware RFC 3339 datetime string
(e.g., "2024-04-01T00:00:00Z"). Events are included only if event_end > timeMin.
IMPORTANT: If an event ends EXACTLY at timeMin, it is EXCLUDED (exclusive boundary).
For recurring events with singleEvents=False: Returns the master event if ANY instance's end time > timeMin.
For recurring events with singleEvents=True: Only returns instances whose end time > timeMin.
Defaults to None.

timeMax.description:
Upper bound (exclusive) for event start times. Must be timezone-aware RFC 3339 datetime string
(e.g., "2024-04-01T23:59:59Z"). Events are included only if event_start < timeMax.
IMPORTANT: For recurring events with singleEvents=True, expansion is capped at ~730 days (~2 years)
from current time regardless of timeMax value.
For recurring events with singleEvents=False: Returns the master event if ANY instance starts before timeMax.
Defaults to None.

q.description: The query string to filter events by. Takes a query term and then matches it with the summary, description, location, or attendees' data such as email and display name of the event. Defaults to None.

singleEvents.description:
Whether to expand recurring events into individual instances.

When True: Recurring events are expanded into separate instances within the time range.
Modified instances show their updated values. Cancelled instances are excluded.

IMPORTANT EXPANSION BEHAVIORS:
- Maximum expansion is ~730 days (~2 years) from current time, regardless of timeMax
- BYMONTHDAY values that don't exist in a month are SKIPPED (RFC 5545 compliant):
  Example: BYMONTHDAY=31 skips Feb, Apr, Jun, Sep, Nov (does NOT fall back to last day)
- EXDATE takes precedence over RDATE: If same date is in both, it is EXCLUDED
- All-day events preserve date-only format in expanded instances

When False: Returns the master recurring event (if any instance falls within the time range),
plus any modified instances and cancelled instances as separate items.
- Master event has 'recurrence' field with RRULE, no 'recurringEventId'
- Modified instances have 'recurringEventId' pointing to master, no 'recurrence'
- Cancelled instances have status='cancelled' and 'recurringEventId', no 'recurrence'

Defaults to False.

orderBy.description:
The order of the events.
Must be one of: "startTime", "updated". Defaults to None.

timeZone.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. Defaults to empty string. If empty or not provided, the calendar's time zone is used.

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional. Defaults to '0'.

name: move_event
description: Moves an event from one calendar to another.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the source calendar. Must not be empty or whitespace.

eventId.description: The identifier of the event to move. Must not be empty or whitespace.

destination.description: The identifier of the destination calendar. Must not be empty or whitespace.

sendUpdates.description:
Whether to send updates about the move.
Possible values: "all", "externalOnly", "none". Defaults to "none".

name: patch_access_control_rule
description: Updates specific fields of an existing access control rule.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar containing the rule.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule to update.

sendNotifications.description: Whether to send notifications about this patch. Defaults to True.

resource.description: The fields to update (required):

type.description:
The type of the scope. Possible values are:
"default" - The public scope. This is the default value.
"user" - Limits the scope to a single user.
"group" - Limits the scope to a group.
"domain" - Limits the scope to a domain.

value.description: The email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain, depending on the scope type. Omitted for type "default".

name: patch_calendar_list_entry
description: Updates specific fields of an existing calendar list entry.

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar list entry to patch. Cannot be empty and must not exceed 255 characters. If "primary" is provided, the primary calendar will be patched.

colorRgbFormat.description: Whether to use the foregroundColor and backgroundColor fields to write the calendar colors (RGB). If this feature is used, the index-based colorId field will be set to the best matching option automatically. Optional. The default is False.

resource.description: The resource to patch the calendar list entry with. Required. Patch semantic: only non-None explicit values trigger an update; None values and omitted fields preserve the existing value.

id.description: READ-ONLY: The id comes from the calendarId parameter. This field is ignored if sent.

summary.description: READ-ONLY: The summary comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

description.description: READ-ONLY: The description comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

timeZone.description: READ-ONLY: The timeZone comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

location.description: READ-ONLY: The location comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

primary.description: READ-ONLY: The primary flag comes from the underlying calendar. This field is ignored if sent.

summaryOverride.description: The summary that the authenticated user has set for this calendar. Patch semantic: only update if explicitly provided with non-None value.

selected.description: Whether the calendar content shows up in the calendar UI. Patch semantic: only update if explicitly provided with non-None value.

colorId.description: The color of the calendar. This is an ID referring to an entry in the calendar section of the colors definition (see the colors endpoint). This property is superseded by the backgroundColor and foregroundColor properties and can be ignored when using these properties. Patch semantic: only update if explicitly provided with non-None value.

backgroundColor.description: The main color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format '#0088aa'. This property supersedes the index-based colorId property. To set or change this property, you need to specify colorRgbFormat=true. Must be provided together with foregroundColor. Patch semantic: only update if explicitly provided with non-None value.

foregroundColor.description: The foreground color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format '#ffffff'. This property supersedes the index-based colorId property. name: patch_event
description:
Updates specific fields of an existing event.

This function allows partial updates to an event by providing only the fields
that need to be changed.

eventId.description: The identifier of the event to update.

calendarId.description: The identifier of the calendar. Defaults to "primary".

resource.description: The event to patch. Defaults to None. May contain:

start.description: The start time of the event. If provided, merges with the existing start time (only provided sub-fields are updated, existing sub-fields are preserved).

date.description: The date of the start time in format YYYY-MM-DD. An event must have either date or dateTime field and cannot have both at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the start time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. An event must have either date or dateTime field and cannot have both at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the start time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). The timeZone is required if the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Defaults to None.

end.description: The end time of the event. If provided, merges with the existing end time (only provided sub-fields are updated, existing sub-fields are preserved).

date.description: The date of the end time in format YYYY-MM-DD. An event must have either date or dateTime field and cannot have both at the same time. Default to None.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the end time in RFC 3339 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. If the dateTime string does not contain timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), then timeZone should be provided. If dateTime contains timezone information (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM), then timeZone is ignored. An event must have either date or dateTime field and cannot have both at the same time. Default to None.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the end time in IANA format (e.g., "America/New_York"). Defaults to None.

recurrence.description:
The recurrence rules of the event in RRULE format and exception dates in EXDATE format.
 Examples:
- Daily for 5 occurrences: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5"]
- Weekly on Monday and Wednesday: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE"]
- Monthly on the 15th: ["RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=15"]
- Yearly on January 1st: ["RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=1;BYMONTHDAY=1"]
- Every 2 weeks: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2"]
- Until a specific date: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20241231T235959Z"]
- With exception dates: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO", "EXDATE:20241225T120000Z", "EXDATE:20250101T120000Z"]
- Multiple exception dates: ["RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10", "EXDATE:20241225T120000Z", "EXDATE:20241226T120000Z"]
- All-day event exceptions: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO", "EXDATE:20241225", "EXDATE:20250101"]
Supported RRULE parameters:
- FREQ: MINUTELY, HOURLY, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY (required)
- INTERVAL: Positive integer (default: 1)
- COUNT: Positive integer (number of occurrences)
- UNTIL: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ (UTC required; Z suffix required for date-time)
- BYDAY: SU,MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA (with optional ordinal: 1SU, -1MO)
- BYMONTH: 1-12
- BYMONTHDAY: 1-31
- BYYEARDAY: 1-366
- BYWEEKNO: 1-53
- BYHOUR: 0-23
- BYMINUTE: 0-59
- BYSECOND: 0-59
- BYSETPOS: 1-366 or -366 to -1
- WKST: SU,MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA (week start)
Supported EXDATE format:
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ (UTC timezone)
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS (floating/local time)
- EXDATE:YYYYMMDD (date only for all-day events)
- Multiple dates: Use separate EXDATE entries (not comma-separated)
Note: TZID parameter not supported in this implementation
